messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected: /v1/generate returning 5xx across multiple hosts in us-west-2. Error rate 35% over last 5m. Pager -> olivia (oncall). Auto-created incident record: INC-2026-0421.

olivia (oncall): taking this. joining bridge in 1m — link: https://redwood-bridge.example.com/INC-2026-0421 (pw in vault). Will do quick blast radius check then update status page.

kai (sre-lead): on the bridge. seeing CPU spike on inference-pool-3 and a few OOMs on node-gpu-14. rolling out temporary routing to hot-backup cluster to reduce load. ETA ~8m.

mike (eng): I can push a quick config to cap concurrent streams per model to 50 to prevent KV cache thrash. Pushing now.

mike (eng): deployed caps to routing layer, watching. logs: ```
2026-04-21T18:12:03Z ERROR model-serving: OOM on node-gpu-14, pid=4238
2026-04-21T18:12:15Z WARN routing: moved 34 reqs/s to backup-cluster
```

olivia (oncall): thanks. initial impact assessment: ~18% of requests currently failing, customers in trial and a few paid tenants in us-west-2 affected. No billing impact yet. Jordan, can you pull a list of customers > $1k/month with requests hitting us-west-2 in last hour?

jordan (support): pulling. ETA 6m. Also flagging support triage channel so we can prepare short customer notifications.

ana (product): prepping status page copy. Draft below — please keep edits short.

ana (product): ```
We are investigating elevated error rates for the /v1/generate endpoint affecting some customers in US-West (Apr 21, 18:10 UTC). Our on-call team has implemented traffic reroutes and is actively investigating the root cause. We will post updates every 30 minutes. If you are experiencing an outage, please reply to this incident and include request IDs and region.
```

olivia (oncall): good. Add note about potential latency for rerouted traffic and mention workaround: set model variant to compact-qa-1 for now.

ana (product): updated draft included.

tessa (marketing): prepping external social draft — want to align on timing. Suggest wait until we have stable mitigation (<5% errors) before any public tweet. Draft below for ops account: 

tessa (marketing): ```
We're aware of an issue causing elevated errors for some inference requests in US-West. Our team is responding and we've implemented mitigations. We'll share updates here and on our status page; customers can DM for account-specific help.
```

press-team: will need legal sign-off for any public wording referencing customer impact. Tagging @legal. Also recommend we avoid naming specific-paying customers.

legal: acknowledged, will review imminent drafts. Quick note: avoid wording that implies service credit triggers until postmortem confirms SLA thresholds.

kai (sre-lead): mitigation seems to have reduced errors to ~6% after routing and caps. continuing investigation into memory leak in kernel/attention implementation.

olivia (oncall): updating status page to "investigating -> identifying cause" and adding the mitigation note. Status update posted: https://status.redwood.example.com/incidents/INC-2026-0421

incident-bot: status changed to identifying cause by olivia (oncall). Next auto-update scheduled +30m.

mike (eng): I have a reproducer on a staging quantized model that shows unbounded memory growth on long-context sequences. Opening a hotfix PR now. PR: https://git.redwood.example.com/redwood/serve/pulls/5123

mike (eng): hotfix includes a guard to trim KV cache for kernels older than 512 tokens and a fallback to safe-kernel when memory usage exceeds threshold. Tests passing locally.

press-team: timeline for public messaging? If mitigation holds and errors <5% in next 30m we can publish an ops update tweet linking status page. Need comms & legal OK.

tessa (marketing): agreed. draft will be ready once legal confirms wording. We'll queue tweet but hold publish until olivia marks resolved or stable mitigation.

olivia (oncall): action items: 1) SRE continue mitigation and monitor (kai, mike) 2) Product to post and update status page every 30m (ana) 3) Support to prepare customer-specific outreach for top accounts (jordan) 4) Marketing/press/legal to prep public messaging (tessa, press-team, legal). Please react with :thumbsup: when picked up.

kai (sre-lead): :thumbsup: staying on until root cause identified.

mike (eng): :thumbsup: monitoring hotfix deploy.

jordan (support): :thumbsup: compiling top-customer list, will DM security/solutions for account context.

incident-bot: note — customer notification template available at https://confluence.redwood.example.com/display/OPS/incident-templates. Suggested short customer message included below for copy/paste: 

incident-bot: ```
Short customer note (for support use):
Hi <CustomerName>,
We're currently investigating elevated errors in our inference API affecting requests routed to US-West. Our engineering team is actively mitigating and we've rerouted traffic for some customers. We do not believe there is a billing impact at this time. We'll follow up within 60 minutes with next steps. If you can share request IDs or timestamps, that helps our investigation.
```

ana (product): adding that to support binder. Also prepping internal comms template for execs: one-paragraph summary + customer impact list + mitigation status.

press-team: once legal signs off, who will publish the tweet? marketing ops or press?

tessa (marketing): I'll publish from the ops account once I get the green light. Please ping me in this thread when olivia says stable.

legal: reviewed wording, OK with current drafts but keep the "no SLA implication" phrase out. We'll need the post-incident report for any press follow-ups.

olivia (oncall): marking next update in 30m. If errors drop <5% by then, we will publish the short ops tweet and close customer-facing incident notification. If not, escalate to oncall rotation for expanded mitigation.

mike (eng): hotfix has been merged to canary, increasing canary capacity to 20% traffic. Observability hooks added for memory + KV size.

kai (sre-lead): seeing errors at 3.8% now. Good signal.

olivia (oncall): great — marking incident as mitigated in status page (link above) and asking marketing to publish prepared ops tweet.

tessa (marketing): publishing now from @RedwoodOps: "We're aware of an issue causing elevated errors for some inference requests in US-West. We've implemented mitigations and services are returning to normal; full details on our status page." will include link to status.

press-team: please archive all message snapshots and collect request IDs for the postmortem. I'll coordinate executive summary after RC.

olivia (oncall): incident set to resolved- monitoring for 1h. Closing bridge in 10m unless regressions. Thanks team. :sparkles: 

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-0421 status -> resolved (mitigated) by olivia (oncall).

jordan (support): prepping outbound emails for top affected customers, using the template. Will post drafts to this thread for review.

ana (product): adding postmortem owner: mike (eng) and timeline to Confluence.

mike (eng): will own postmortem and include timeline, root cause (KV cache leak + kernel selection), and remediation plan (longer-term kernel hardening + QA with long-context tests).

olivia (oncall): thanks everyone. filing final status update and close.
